title: Close the in-memory UserDatabase created inline in settings test ProviderScope overrides
rule: TQ-6-adjacent (test resource hygiene / Nygard: unreleased I/O resource)
why: _sheetOverrides / _buildApp in these 4 files each construct `UserDatabase(NativeDatabase.memory())` inline and never capture a reference to close it — unlike the `DeviceRegistryDatabase` created in the same functions, which is correctly torn down via `addTearDown(registry.close)` (verified by grep: registry.close appears, db.close never does, in any of the 4 files). account_actions_test.dart alone calls its factory from ~19 separate testWidgets cases, so a single run of just this batch leaks on the order of 25+ native SQLite (FFI) connections that are never released.
recommendation: Capture the constructed UserDatabase into a local variable in each factory and close it via addTearDown(db.close) or the existing tearDown, mirroring the registry.close() pattern already present in the same 4 functions.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 4 files' UserDatabase(NativeDatabase.memory()) instances is closed by the end of every test that constructs one.
